description: Dashboard visualizing ContainerLogV2 records collected by Azure Monitor

options.content:
## ContainerLogV2 – Analytics Tier (Standard View)

This out-of-box dashboard provides visibility into [ContainerLogV2](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-monitor/containers/container-insights-logs-schema) data ingested at the [Analytics tier](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-monitor/logs/data-platform-logs#table-plans). 
It offers high-query fidelity with support for advanced aggregations and rich visualizations. This view does not include Kubernetes metadata, and is suited for users who need full analytical capabilities without requiring pod-level context.

If you have enabled Kubernetes metadata on your ContainerLogV2 table, then use the [ContainerLogV2 - Standard](https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/20995-azure-insights-containers-containerlogv2/) dashboard. 
If you are ingesting ContainerLogV2 in the Basic tier, refer to the [ContainerLogV2 – Basic Tier (Standard View](https://aka.ms/ContainerLogV2BasicTier) dashboard. 

Please note that this dashboard does not work with the ContainerLog schema, which is now retired. [Learn More](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/answers/questions/1406562/retirement-announcement-containerlog-schema-suppor)

azureLogAnalytics.query:
ContainerLogV2
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where _ResourceId =~ "/subscriptions/$sub/resourcegroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/$res"
| where "$ns" == "__all" or PodNamespace in~ ($ns)
| summarize Count = count() by LogLevel

ContainerLogV2
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where _ResourceId =~ "/subscriptions/$sub/resourcegroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/$res"
| where "$ns" == "__all" or PodNamespace in~ ($ns)
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), LogLevel
| order by TimeGenerated asc 
| render timechart

ContainerLogV2
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where _ResourceId =~ "/subscriptions/$sub/resourcegroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/$res"
| where "$ns" == "__all" or PodNamespace in~ ($ns)
| extend DataVolume = _BilledSize
| summarize TotalDataVolume = round(sum(DataVolume), 4)

ContainerLogV2
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where _ResourceId =~ "/subscriptions/$sub/resourcegroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/$res"
| where "$ns" == "__all" or PodNamespace in~ ($ns)
| extend DataVolumeMB = _BilledSize
| extend TimeGenerated = now()
| summarize TotalDataVolumeMB = round(sum(DataVolumeMB), 2) by TimeGenerated, Computer
| evaluate pivot(Computer, sum(TotalDataVolumeMB))

ContainerLogV2
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where _ResourceId =~ "/subscriptions/$sub/resourcegroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/$res"
| where "$ns" == "__all" or PodNamespace in~ ($ns)
| extend DataVolumeMB = _BilledSize
| extend TimeGenerated = now()
| summarize TotalDataVolumeMB = round(sum(DataVolumeMB), 2) by TimeGenerated, PodNamespace
| evaluate pivot(PodNamespace, sum(TotalDataVolumeMB))

ContainerLogV2
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where _ResourceId =~ "/subscriptions/$sub/resourcegroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/$res"
| where "$ns" == "__all" or PodNamespace in~ ($ns)
| extend DataVolumeMB = _BilledSize
| summarize TotalDataVolumeMB = round(sum(DataVolumeMB), 2) by PodName
| extend TimeGenerated = now()
| evaluate pivot(PodName, sum(TotalDataVolumeMB))

ContainerLogV2
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where _ResourceId =~ "/subscriptions/$sub/resourcegroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/$res"
| where "$ns" == "__all" or PodNamespace in~ ($ns)
| extend DataVolumeMB = _BilledSize
| summarize TotalDataVolumeMB = round(sum(DataVolumeMB), 4) by ContainerName
| extend TimeGenerated = now()
| evaluate pivot(ContainerName, sum(TotalDataVolumeMB))

ContainerLogV2
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where _ResourceId =~ "/subscriptions/$sub/resourcegroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/$res"
| where "$ns" == "__all" or PodNamespace in~ ($ns)
| summarize CountPerMinute = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
| summarize AverageLogRatePerMinute = avg(CountPerMinute)

ContainerLogV2
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where _ResourceId =~ "/subscriptions/$sub/resourcegroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/$res"
| where "$ns" == "__all" or PodNamespace in~ ($ns)
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), Computer
| order by TimeGenerated asc 
| render timechart

ContainerLogV2
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where _ResourceId =~ "/subscriptions/$sub/resourcegroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/$res"
| where "$ns" == "__all" or PodNamespace in~ ($ns)
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), PodNamespace
| order by TimeGenerated asc 
| render timechart

ContainerLogV2
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where _ResourceId =~ "/subscriptions/$sub/resourcegroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/$res"
| where "$ns" == "__all" or PodNamespace in~ ($ns)
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), PodName
| order by TimeGenerated asc 
| render timechart

ContainerLogV2
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where _ResourceId =~ "/subscriptions/$sub/resourcegroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/$res"
| where "$ns" == "__all" or PodNamespace in~ ($ns)
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), ContainerName
| order by TimeGenerated asc 
| render timechart

ContainerLogV2
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where _ResourceId =~ "/subscriptions/$sub/resourcegroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/$res"
| where "$ns" == "__all" or PodNamespace in~ ($ns)
| summarize TotalCount = count()

ContainerLogV2
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where _ResourceId =~ "/subscriptions/$sub/resourcegroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/$res"
| where "$ns" == "__all" or PodNamespace in~ ($ns)
| summarize LogCount = count() by Computer
| extend TimeGenerated = now()

ContainerLogV2
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where _ResourceId =~ "/subscriptions/$sub/resourcegroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/$res"
| where "$ns" == "__all" or PodNamespace in~ ($ns)
| summarize LogCount = count() by PodNamespace
| extend TimeGenerated = now()

ContainerLogV2
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where _ResourceId =~ "/subscriptions/$sub/resourcegroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/$res"
| where "$ns" == "__all" or PodNamespace in~ ($ns)
| summarize LogCount = count() by PodName
| extend TimeGenerated = now()

ContainerLogV2
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where _ResourceId =~ "/subscriptions/$sub/resourcegroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/$res"
| where "$ns" == "__all" or PodNamespace in~ ($ns)
| summarize LogCount = count() by ContainerName
| extend TimeGenerated = now()

ContainerLogV2
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where _ResourceId =~ "/subscriptions/$sub/resourcegroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/$res"
| extend NamespaceInput = "$ns"
| where NamespaceInput == "__all" or PodNamespace in~ ($ns)
| where LogLevel in~ ($sev)
| project TimeGenerated, LogMessage, LogLevel, PodName, Computer, ContainerName, ContainerId
| top 100 by TimeGenerated desc

azureResourceGraph.query:
Resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters'
| where id =~ "/subscriptions/$sub/resourcegroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/$res"
| extend props = parse_json(properties)
| extend lawResourceId = tostring(props.addonProfiles.omsAgent.config.logAnalyticsWorkspaceResourceID)
| extend LAWS = iff(isnotempty(lawResourceId), lawResourceId, tostring(props.addonProfiles.omsagent.config.logAnalyticsWorkspaceResourceID))
| project LAWS
